repos.name: EL4CTEO/fast-anything
repos.description: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow: profile Python, Node or Ruby apps, port the hot functions with your coding agent, prove they behave the same.
repos.one_liner: A performance optimization toolkit that helps developers identify and rewrite critical hot paths in Python, Node, or Ruby using Rust.
bullets: Built in Rust for high-performance execution and memory safety.
Integrates with coding agents to automate the porting of performance-critical functions.
Focuses on the '5% rule' to optimize application bottlenecks without requiring a full rewrite.
Useful for scaling high-frequency trading systems or data-intensive fintech backends.

repos.name: pierridotite/mobile-agent-testers
repos.description: 20 AI testers on 20 different phones, in parallel, on GitHub's free runners: Claude Code agents on iOS Simulators and Android emulators that find broken flows, translation, layout and accessibility bugs
repos.one_liner: A parallelized testing framework that uses AI agents to perform automated UI testing on mobile emulators and simulators.
bullets: Leverages Claude Code agents to navigate iOS and Android environments.
Runs 20+ agents in parallel on GitHub free runners for cost-effective CI/CD.
Detects broken flows, layout issues, and accessibility compliance automatically.
Ideal for fintech apps requiring rigorous cross-device regression testing.

repos.name: erkamyaman/safe-anything
repos.description: Find the holes before someone else does. A fast, 100% Rust vulnerability scanner: XSS, SQL injection, leaked secrets, dependency CVEs and AI agent setups.
repos.one_liner: A high-speed, 100% Rust-based vulnerability scanner designed to detect security flaws in modern software stacks.
bullets: Written in Rust to ensure rapid scanning speeds across large codebases.
Detects XSS, SQL injection, leaked secrets, and dependency-based CVEs.
Includes specific security checks for AI agent configurations and integrations.
Essential for DevSecOps pipelines in highly regulated financial environments.
